request_text:
Add a legal color-role confounding gate — highest priority

**Symptom.** The semantic gate can refute a global numeric-color sorter while
missing a profile-conditioned sorter. In
`checks/audit/89704f9047c0/probe.json`, dimensions plus the color set predict the
invented corner assignment on 480/480 generated draws; the rival ignores actual
corner placement and fails a Racket-checked lawful input. The selected baseline
had the related palette→direction shortcut.

**Suggested change.** Extend the semantic lesson tooling with an opt-in
`INTERCHANGEABLE_COLOR_ROLES` contract. For accepted color permutations, test
simple rivals conditioned on every advertised axis/profile and sample-schedule
slot. Require Racket confirmation only for a minimal accepted witness. Keep the
feature opt-in so fixed-symbol tasks are not falsely flagged.
